perspective:
**Jose Castillo’s available information:**

- Jose works with Patricia Ndiaye at a community bank and sometimes helps with maintenance/repairs. They have a friendly, professional relationship.
- Jose observed Patricia looking more withdrawn than usual during their shifts, compared to her normally vibrant demeanor.
- Jose asked if she was okay. Patricia said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- Jose offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk. Patricia said she appreciated it and that it meant a lot.
- During a lunch break, Jose overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- Jose mentioned he’d been reading about financial planning strategies and offered to discuss them. Patricia said that could be helpful because she’d been “a bit overwhelmed” with her bills lately.
- Jose offered to look over budgeting tips together and told her to let him know when she felt up to it. Patricia said she’d take him up on it soon.
- Jose later worried he might have overstepped, so he clarified he only wanted to help, not pry. Patricia assured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer.
- Jose said he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. Patricia said she appreciated that and was glad she had someone to turn to.
- In a later conversation, Jose asked how she was and if she had weekend plans. Patricia said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- Jose mentioned he’d probably read and relax, and reminded her she could reach out if she needed anything. Patricia thanked him and said she’d keep it in mind.
- Jose continues to check in with Patricia at work to maintain a supportive presence. Patricia has told him she’s busy but handling things, appreciates his support, and will let him know if she needs anything.
